title: Context bundle role manifest
description: Frontmatter contract for 4b_setup/manifests/roles/<role>.md — provider-neutral role metadata following the claude-skills frontmatter taxonomy (name/description + declarative extensions). The compiler (compile-context-bundles.mjs) projects these into canonical bundles plus Claude/Codex projections; the injector (context-injector.mjs) matches spawned subagent types against `matcher`. The source-id -> path map and the hard never-inject list (whole PRDs, other stories' wave plans, progress.md, SKILL.md texts, src/**/agent.md) live in the compiler, not here: a manifest can only pick from the closed `inject` vocabulary below.

name.description: Role id, unique across manifests, e.g. frontend-implementer

description.description: When this role is spawned (claude-skills style: trigger conditions, not prose)

tier.description: Spawn tier (CONCEPT.md §5): 0 = micro-fix, inject NOTHING; 1 = story implementer, full type-scoped pack; 2 = reviewer/QA persona, minimal pack. Explore-type roles are modeled as tier 2 with inject: [].

scope.description: Which side of the type-scoped injection matrix applies

inject.description: Ordered source ids compiled into the canonical bundle. Empty array = no bundle is compiled and the injector emits nothing (tier 0, explore).

budget_tokens.description: Hard token budget for the compiled bundle (heuristic ceil(chars/4)); compile fails and writes nothing on breach

matcher.description: Regex (unanchored, case-insensitive) matched against the spawned subagent type by the injector hook

claude.description: Claude projection: how this role lands in .claude/agents/skillchain-<name>.md

tools.description: Comma-separated tool allowlist for the agent file

codex.description: Codex projection: prompt-file delivery (no SubagentStart equivalent)

delivery.description: Codex lanes read specs/.../context/bundle-<role>.codex.md before implementing

sandbox.description: Codex sandbox mode the role runs under, e.g. workspace-write / read-only
